requirements.title: Specific type-bound procedure designators dispatch by dynamic type
requirements.definition: For a procedure-designator whose binding-name is a specific type-bound procedure, the referenced procedure is the one bound to that name in the dynamic type of the data-ref.

pending.specific-type-bound-dispatch-by-dynamic-: Declare parent type with binding val returning 11 and extension overriding val returning 42; through CLASS(parent) data-ref holding a child object, call obj%val() and verify 42. Also create extension ext that inherits val without override and call through CLASS(ext), verifying inherited parent result 11; add NON_OVERRIDABLE binding fixed returning 13 and verify child dispatch still returns 13. For explicit PASS(rhs), binding pick(left,rhs) has passed-object dummy rhs and integer left; object tag 37 plus left 5 returns 42, proving the named passed-object dummy receives the data-ref.

requirements.title: Generic type-bound procedure references select specific bindings from the declared type
requirements.definition: For a generic type-bound procedure binding, the generic binding of the declared type selects a specific binding: first a specific binding consistent with the reference, otherwise a specific binding consistent with an elemental reference.

pending.declared-type-generic-specific-selected: Parent declared type has generic g => scalar specific gs returning 21 and vector specific gv returning 42. Call through CLASS(parent) with a vector actual and verify the declared-type generic selects gv for 42. Add generic h => pick where pick(left,rhs) uses PASS(rhs); object tag 37 and explicit integer left 5 return 42, proving generic selection uses the explicit passed-object dummy position.
pending.declared-type-generic-elemental-fallback: Parent declared type has generic g with scalar elemental ge returning x+100 and no rank-two nonelemental match; call with RESHAPE([1,2,3,4],[2,2]) and verify exact elemental matrix [101,102,103,104] in column-major order. Extension ext inherits ge without override; CLASS(ext) dispatch through the same generic verifies the inherited elemental result [101,102,103,104].

requirements.title: Selected type-bound specifics dispatch to the same binding name in the dynamic type
requirements.definition: After generic type-bound selection identifies a specific binding, the procedure reference is to the procedure bound to the same name as that selected specific binding in the dynamic type of the data-ref.

pending.selected-specific-binding-dispatches-in-: Parent generic g selects specific binding pi for integer actual; child overrides pi to return 42 while parent pi returns 11. Through CLASS(parent) holding child, call obj%g(1) and verify 42, proving declared-type selection followed by dynamic-type dispatch of the same specific binding name.
